name: Server-Authoritative Trade Flow
description: A reusable multiplayer trade composition: client transport opens a trade, the coordinator validates and commits it server-side, then the transport and UI receive authoritative result events.

connections.note: Remote transport requests a server-authoritative trade session.
Coordinator returns validated state to both clients.
Coordinator returns the final committed transaction result.
UI updates only after the server confirms the swap.
UI displays the server-authoritative failure state.

acceptanceCriteria: A client request cannot commit a trade without coordinator validation.
The trade window reacts to committed or rejected results from the coordinator, not to client assumptions.
Item and currency ownership are checked by the server authority before commit.
Transport is rate-limited and does not become the source of truth.
